facts.value: Arizona State University’s online Bachelor of Science in Planning in urban planning teaches theories and practices for creating equitable, healthy and happy communities. In this unique program, you’ll study transportation, business districts, neighborhoods, green space and more.

metadata.chunk_title: Online Bachelor of Science in Planning in Urban Planning + Why earn an urban planning degree?

facts.value: You’ll be equipped with the knowledge and experience needed to design impactful communities.
